title: Replace if/elif chain with a dispatch table
requirement:
shapes.area(shape) picks the formula with an if/elif chain on shape['kind']. Refactor it to look the
formula up in a module-level dict AREA_FUNCS (kind -> function taking the shape dict), so new kinds can
be registered without editing area(). Unknown kinds still raise ValueError. Results must not change.
acceptance_criteria: registering AREA_FUNCS['triangle'] makes area() support it
